# PursTech
> The World's Largest Free Tool Ecosystem. Stop Searching. Start Doing.

PursTech (purstech.com) is a free online tool platform providing utilities for text
processing, image editing, developer tools, SEO, AI-powered tasks, finance calculations,
security and PDF management. No login required for any tool. 100% browser-based
processing — user data never leaves the device. Powered by Claude AI (Anthropic).

## Technical Details

- Framework:   Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS)
- Hosting:     Vercel (global CDN)
- Database:    Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- AI:          Claude (Anthropic)
- Processing:  100% client-side for all tool operations
- Privacy:     No user data transmitted to servers during tool use

## About

- Founder:        Independent developer
- Technology:     Next.js, Supabase, Vercel, Claude AI
- Business model: Free tools + optional Pro tier ($7/month)
- Contact:        contact@purstech.com
